title: kbingest run_tool leaves the mapper's process group alive on an interrupt
goal: run_tool kills the process tree on any BaseException raised while it waits (KeyboardInterrupt included) and re-raises, so the scratch worktree is never removed under a live mapper; a test named kbingest_map_interrupt_kills_group proves the child is gone (sprint SP-fkyrld5h review finding F9)
